messages:
zoe: New engineer here—hit a streaming oddity in the Node quickstart. If I ctrl-c and immediately restart the sample, sometimes the last token is emitted twice or a short fragment precedes the resume marker.

matt: Thanks for the repro. Which SDK/version and OS?

zoe: Node SDK 1.0.0-rc, macOS, steps: start samples/stream, send prompt, ctrl-c mid-chunk, then restart within ~100-200ms. Repro ~30% locally.

oliver: Sounds like the reconnect path + auth refresh or buffered flush debounce racing and replaying a buffered chunk while resume metadata is applied.

zoe: Minimal curl repro for infra folks:
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"quick reconnect test"}'
```

matt: CI?

ci-bot: attached build 9123: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/9123 (streaming-onboard-flaky)

oliver: Short-term mitigation: add 250ms reconnect jitter in the quickstart and bump demo token TTL for onboarding. Longer-term: server include monotonic per-chunk seq in resume metadata (e.g., header x-rw-seq) and SDK emits a "resumed" event with last-seen-seq so clients can dedupe/reorder. Also make teardown flush deterministic (skip debounce).

zoe: I'll add a tiny change to the sample app to show the jitter toggle and include a dedupe snippet in the quickstart README.

devx-bot: Added onboarding checklist note: "If duplicates on reconnect, enable sample reconnect jitter or upgrade demo token TTL."

matt: Filed RED-6123 for server seq header + SDK resume event. Plan: small server tag rollout + node/python parity test.

oliver: Great. Thanks for reporting and the repro steps—helps onboarding a lot. :thumbsup:
